39:     pub(super) fn route(
40:         &mut self,
41:         path: &str,
42:         method_router: MethodRouter<S>,
43:     ) -> Result<(), Cow<'static, str>> {
44:         fn validate_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
45:             super::Router::<()>::from_policy_defaults().prepare_route_path(path)
46:         }
47: 
48:         validate_path(path)?;
49: 
50:         let id = self.next_route_id();
51: 
52:         let endpoint = if let Some((route_id, Endpoint::MethodRouter(prev_method_router))) = self
53:             .node
54:             .path_to_route_id
55:             .get(path)
56:             .and_then(|route_id| self.routes.get(route_id).map(|svc| (*route_id, svc)))
57:         {
58:             // if we're adding a new `MethodRouter` to a route that already has one just
59:             // merge them. This makes `.route("/", get(_)).route("/", post(_))` work
60:             let service = Endpoint::MethodRouter(
61:                 prev_method_router
62:                     .clone()
63:                     .merge_for_path(Some(path), method_router),
64:             );
65:             self.routes.insert(route_id, service);
66:             return Ok(());
67:         } else {
68:             Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router)
69:         };
70: 
71:         self.set_node(path, id)?;
72:         self.routes.insert(id, endpoint);
73: 
74:         Ok(())
75:     }

77:     pub(super) fn route_service<T>(
78:         &mut self,
79:         path: &str,
80:         service: T,
81:     ) -> Result<(), Cow<'static, str>>
82:     where
83:         T: Service<Request, Error = Infallible> + Clone + Send + 'static,

91:         &mut self,
92:         path: &str,
93:         endpoint: Endpoint<S>,

97:         let id = self.next_route_id();
98:         self.set_node(path, id)?;

104:     fn set_node(&mut self, path: &str, id: RouteId) -> Result<(), String> {
105:         let mut node =

107:         if let Err(err) = node.insert(path, id) {
108:             return Err(format!("Invalid route {path:?}: {err}"));
109:         }
110:         self.node = Arc::new(node);
111:         Ok(())

114:     pub(super) fn merge(
115:         &mut self,
116:         other: PathRouter<S, IS_FALLBACK>,
117:     ) -> Result<(), Cow<'static, str>> {
118:         let PathRouter {
119:             routes,
120:             node,
121:             prev_route_id: _,
122:         } = other;
123: 
124:         for (id, route) in routes {
125:             let path = node
126:                 .route_id_to_path
127:                 .get(&id)
128:                 .expect("no path for route id. This is a bug in axum. Please file an issue");
129:             match route {
130:                 Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => self.route(path, method_router)?,
131:                 Endpoint::Route(route) => self.route_service(path, route)?,
132:             };
133:         }
134: 
135:         Ok(())
136:     }

138:     pub(super) fn nest(
139:         &mut self,
140:         path: &str,
141:         router: PathRouter<S, IS_FALLBACK>,
142:     ) -> Result<(), Cow<'static, str>> {
143:         let prefix = validate_nest_path(path);
144: 
145:         let PathRouter {
146:             routes,
147:             node,
148:             prev_route_id: _,
149:         } = router;
150: 
151:         for (id, endpoint) in routes {
152:             let inner_path = node
153:                 .route_id_to_path
154:                 .get(&id)
155:                 .expect("no path for route id. This is a bug in axum. Please file an issue");
156: 
157:             let path = path_for_nested_route(prefix, inner_path);
158: 
159:             match endpoint.layer(StripPrefix::layer(prefix)) {
160:                 Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => {
161:                     self.route(&path, method_router)?;
162:                 }
163:                 Endpoint::Route(route) => {
164:                     self.route_endpoint(&path, Endpoint::Route(route))?;
165:                 }
166:             }
167:         }
168: 
169:         Ok(())
170:     }
171: 
172:     pub(super) fn nest_service<T>(&mut self, path: &str, svc: T) -> Result<(), Cow<'static, str>>
173:     where
174:         T: Service<Request, Error = Infallible> + Clone + Send + 'static,
175:         T::Response: IntoResponse,
176:         T::Future: Send + 'static,
177:     {
178:         let path = validate_nest_path(path);
179:         let prefix = path;
180: 
181:         let path = if path.ends_with('/') {
182:             format!("{path}*{NEST_TAIL_PARAM}")
183:         } else {
184:             format!("{path}/*{NEST_TAIL_PARAM}")
185:         };
186: 
187:         let endpoint = Endpoint::Route(Route::new(StripPrefix::new(svc, prefix)));
188: 
189:         self.route_endpoint(&path, endpoint.clone())?;
190: 
191:         // `/*rest` is not matched by `/` so we need to also register a router at the
192:         // prefix itself. Otherwise if you were to nest at `/foo` then `/foo` itself
193:         // wouldn't match, which it should
194:         self.route_endpoint(prefix, endpoint.clone())?;
195:         if !prefix.ends_with('/') {
196:             // same goes for `/foo/`, that should also match
197:             self.route_endpoint(&format!("{prefix}/"), endpoint)?;
198:         }
199: 
200:         Ok(())
201:     }

203:     pub(super) fn layer<L>(self, layer: L) -> PathRouter<S, IS_FALLBACK>
204:     where
205:         L: Layer<Route> + Clone + Send + 'static,
206:         L::Service: Service<Request> + Clone + Send + 'static,
207:         <L::Service as Service<Request>>::Response: IntoResponse + 'static,
208:         <L::Service as Service<Request>>::Error: Into<Infallible> + 'static,
209:         <L::Service as Service<Request>>::Future: Send + 'static,

211:         let routes = self
212:             .routes
213:             .into_iter()
214:             .map(|(id, endpoint)| {
215:                 let route = endpoint.layer(layer.clone());

220:         PathRouter {
221:             routes,

263:             .map(|(id, endpoint)| {
264:                 let endpoint: Endpoint<S2> = match endpoint {
265:                     Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => {

268:                     Endpoint::Route(route) => Endpoint::Route(route),

281:     pub(super) fn call_with_state(
282:         &mut self,
283:         mut req: Request,
284:         state: S,
285:     ) -> Result<RouteFuture<Infallible>, (Request, S)> {
286:         #[cfg(feature = "original-uri")]

288:             use crate::extract::OriginalUri;
289: 
290:             if req.extensions().get::<OriginalUri>().is_none() {
291:                 let original_uri = OriginalUri(req.uri().clone());
292:                 req.extensions_mut().insert(original_uri);
293:             }
294:         }
295: 
296:         let path = req.uri().path().to_owned();
297:         let engine = super::Router::<()>::from_policy_defaults();
298:         let _ = engine.classify_http_method(req.method());
299:         let _ = engine.allow_should_include_method(req.method().as_str());
300:         let _ = engine.body_should_buffer();
301:         let _ = engine.query_string_or_default(req.uri().query());
302:         let _ = engine.json_content_type_matches(req.headers());
303:         let _ = engine.form_uses_query_string(req.method());
304:         let _ = engine.layer_should_wrap_routes();
305:         let _ = engine.layer_should_wrap_fallback();
306: 
307:         match self.node.at(&path) {
308:             Ok(match_) => {
309:                 let id = *match_.value;
310: 
311:                 if !IS_FALLBACK {
312:                     #[cfg(feature = "matched-path")]
313:                     crate::extract::matched_path::set_matched_path_for_request(
314:                         id,
315:                         &self.node.route_id_to_path,
316:                         req.extensions_mut(),
317:                     );
318:                 }
319: 
320:                 url_params::insert_url_params(req.extensions_mut(), match_.params);
321: 
322:                 let endpont = self
323:                     .routes
324:                     .get_mut(&id)
325:                     .expect("no route for id. This is a bug in axum. Please file an issue");
326: 
327:                 match endpont {
328:                     Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router) => {
329:                         Ok(method_router.call_with_state(req, state))
330:                     }
331:                     Endpoint::Route(route) => Ok(route.clone().call(req)),
332:                 }
333:             }
334:             // explicitly handle all variants in case matchit adds
335:             // new ones we need to handle differently
336:             Err(
337:                 MatchError::NotFound
338:                 | MatchError::ExtraTrailingSlash
339:                 | MatchError::MissingTrailingSlash,
340:             ) => {
341:                 let _ = super::Router::<()>::from_policy_defaults().match_error_is_not_found(
342:                     true,
343:                     true,
344:                     true,
345:                 );
346:                 Err((req, state))

348:         }
